description: OpenStreetMap - Roads and Paths - Lines (Australia) 2021 is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by OpenStreetMap. This dataset was extracted from OpenStreetMap (OSM) across the geographic area of Australia on 02 December 2021. Its purpose is to display Roads and Paths as lines within Australia. Note, however, as this dataset is built by a community of mappers, there is no guarantee of its spatial or attribute accuracy. Coverage: Australia. The portal shows 2025-07-31 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
